title: Dora Saves The Mermaids
hook: 美人鱼 Mariana 的珍珠被海盗猪抢走，海也变脏了，Dora 和 Boots 骑海豚去救她。

cells.en: Thanks for helping us clean up the beach, little clam shell!
cells.cn: 谢谢你帮我们一起清理海滩，小贝壳！

cells.en: Boots sees a big ship far out on the water.
cells.cn: Boots 看见远处的海面上有一艘大船。

cells.en: Look at all the numbers! They go over the number bridge.
cells.cn: 看这么多数字！他们要走过数字桥。

cells.en: What number comes after five? Six, then seven.
cells.cn: 五后面是几呢？是六，再往后是七。

cells.en: Swim fast, little fish! Dora knows we can do it.
cells.cn: 小鱼快游！Dora 知道我们一定能做到。

cells.en: Three pirate pigs live in the Silly Sea.
cells.cn: 三只海盗猪住在“傻傻海”里。

cells.en: In the Silly Sea there is a fish that meows. It is a catfish!
cells.cn: 傻傻海里有会喵喵叫的鱼，是猫鱼！

cells.en: Dora and Boots ride dolphins over the blue waves.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 骑着海豚越过蓝色浪花。

cells.en: Now Dora can wish the Mermaid Kingdom clean and bright again.
cells.cn: 现在 Dora 可以许愿让人鱼王国重新干净明亮。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Saves The Mermaids”.
ending: In the end, the sea is clean again and Mariana gets her pearl back. My favorite part is ______.
